headline: Nasdaq Tops Third-Quarter Earnings Estimates as Stock Advances Premarket
summary: Nasdaq beat third-quarter 2026 financial estimates, prompting a premarket increase in its share price.
why: Nasdaq, Inc. operates major global stock exchanges and provides market infrastructure, index licensing, and compliance technology to institutional investors.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Inc
impacts.why: Quarterly earnings surpassing market expectations improve investor confidence in exchange operator revenue growth.
